subject.title: Wear: animate Talk avatar from playback audio

question: Should the bundled Wear Talk screen replace its existing orb-and-waveform default with the animated canonical OpenClaw avatar?
rationale: This is a visible default-experience change with no established broken-behavior contract; correctness and device proof do not establish product acceptance.

options.title: Adopt the avatar default
options.body: Approve the new canonical avatar and merge after the normal Android/Wear required checks complete.

options.title: Retain the current visual
options.body: Keep the existing orb and waveform as the bundled Wear Talk presentation and close the PR as an unaccepted product direction.

options.title: Request a narrower direction
options.body: Ask for a specified visual treatment or an explicitly optional presentation before reconsidering the implementation.

recommendation.title: Adopt the avatar default
recommendation.body: Approve the new canonical avatar and merge after the normal Android/Wear required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the latest audio-animation continuity repair and are the closest identified contributor to the changed rendering path.
